name: surface-recon
description: Run bounded DNS, HTTP, and TLS reconnaissance for an in-scope target.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Domain, host, IP, or URL to inspect.

parameters.name: include_dns
parameters.description: Whether to resolve DNS records for hostname targets.

parameters.name: include_http
parameters.description: Whether to probe derived HTTP and HTTPS URLs.

parameters.name: include_tls
parameters.description: Whether to inspect the derived TLS endpoint.
